# Phase 8 Profile Evaluation Evidence

This immutable offline package evaluates the historical Five-layer v1, Five-layer v2, and Six-layer v1 boundaries. Functional completeness and theoretical capacity are checked before estimated cost. No cloud resource was created and no cross-profile optimizer winner is published.

## Evidence boundary

| Profile | Role | Cost interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| `five-layer-baseline@1` | Historical reconstruction | Separate legacy snapshot; not ranked with active profiles |
| `five-layer-baseline@2` | Functionally aligned control | Profile-local offline estimate |
| `six-layer-eventing@1` | Independent Event Layer treatment | Profile-local offline estimate plus matched-context delta |

## Coverage

- 3 paired Small/Medium/Large workloads;
- 3 single-cloud and 9 L3/L5-to-L4 placements per active profile and size;
- all 6 directed Event-provider pairs per size;
- 1 representative three-provider Six-layer graph per size;
- selected and rejected resolution evidence;
- unsupported and live-unverified cases preserved without publishable totals.

See [cost summary](cost-summary.md), [architecture deltas](architecture-deltas.json), [rejections](rejections.json), [limitations](limitations.json), and [RQ mapping](rq-mapping.json).
